correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the affine determinant and equality argument in RESULT.md:25–48. Nonzero quintuples have a 3+2 split; the determinant magnitude is twice the triangle area times the pair's two-dimensional determinant. Five triangles of each area and five pairs of each type, in either factor order, give multiplicities 52, 50, 100, 50 at the four stated volumes. Independently, the free sum has gauge rho_A(x)+rho_B(y); integrating area(B)(1-u)^2 against 2 area(A)u du gives area(A)area(B)/6 = 25(5+sqrt(5))/192 and hence the stated ratio. At equality, every tuple in the Cartesian product of convex supports must have the same extreme signed determinant. By symmetry use (A0,A1,A3,B0,B1): the three same-sign moves are A0→A4, A1→A2, A3→B3. The first two together give a small triangle; either with the third gives a diagonal A pair. Changing a B vertex within its factor to the other possible adjacent partner flips the sign, while changing it to an A vertex degenerates the simplex. Thus at most one position can move and it has at most two supporting vertices. Each allowed segment is an exposed edge of the body (extend a factor-side functional, or choose a unique maximizing vertex in each factor and normalize the two maxima to agree), so different segment interiors cannot identify unordered simplices. For each fixed adjacent pair the within-composition moves rotate the large triangle by ±2 mod 5, giving a 5-cycle. Each large triangle has exactly one adjacent pair, and the map from the five triangles to these pairs is bijective; the 25 swap-composition edges connect the five cycles on either side with complete bipartite incidence. This proves connectivity, trivalence and all edge counts, including arbitrary points rather than just the 252 vertex subsets.
residual_risks: No numerical hull calculation or formal verification claimed; both are unnecessary for the analytic check.

value.rationale: The body is independently canonical as an ambient volume extremizer, and its largest contained simplex is a natural measure of the separation between enclosing and contained volume. The exact equality set distinguishes discrete optimum vertex choices from continuous, but never two-dimensional, families; it supplies a usable benchmark for rigidity and equality mechanisms in free sums. Neither the four levels nor the connected trivalent optimizer graph is dictated by ambient optimality.
residual_risks: No claim about other polytopes or a general extremal ratio.
